source: Open-Meteo Marine API (selected marine model not exposed by response)

marine_source_contract.model_identity: provider-selected; not exposed in API response
marine_source_contract.coastal_validity: finite values are not sufficient evidence of local validity; consult wave_component_contract and water-support metadata

quality.atmospheric_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API (temperature_2m, pressure_msl, 10 m wind)
quality.notes: The Open-Meteo Marine API combines several marine models and does not expose the selected model in this response. The API requires equal-length lat/lon arrays; we fetch a 23x23 square over the full operational bbox and bilinearly interpolate to the full display grid. Atmospheric 10-m wind is pulled from api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast on the same grid+timeline.

phase_tiles.reason: native phase atlas overlaps this forecast cycle; native horizon is independent

quality.ofs_tidal_source: NOAA NOS Operational Forecast Systems via noaa-ofs-pds

source.range_definition: max-min over complete native HTP horizon
source.method: complete ADCIRC face-bbox intersection; full native HTP horizon; native depth mask; no regular-grid reprojection; no CO-OPS interpolation

native_mesh.representation: precomputed native-mesh contours; raw nodes/faces kept out of Pages payload due 25 MiB file limit

phase_tiles.definition: combined-signal stage from total HTP value and edge-safe time derivative; circular native-triangle phase averaging; high/falling/low/rising; same native triangles as co-range

tide_range_contract.mask: tide_water_cells; at least two corners finite across the complete horizon
tide_range_contract.missing_policy: null; never interpolate land or missing corners

tide_range_definition: full 168-hour harmonic-source max-min; unstable S2 constituent rejected

tide_harmonic_source.method: lazy regional mesh extraction + QC harmonic fit

rejected_constituents.S2: 126-hour fit rejected as ill-conditioned for near-collinear M2/S2 separation

source.method: lazy regional mesh extraction + QC harmonic fit

validation.model: NOAA STOFS HTP + CO-OPS harmonic residual calibration
validation.calibration: complex harmonic residuals; training window only
validation.promotion_gate: LOO coverage and held-out RMSE no worse than untouched STOFS

wave_water_mask_contract.raster_row_order: north_to_south; cell arrays are aggregated after north/south flip to forecast south_to_north order
wave_water_mask_contract.purpose: source water-support metadata; coastline clipping remains a separate high-resolution render mask

swell.source: Open-Meteo Marine API; model selection is not exposed in the response
swell.reason: the source grid is regional/coarse and does not resolve local entrance shielding, bars, fetch, or shallow-water transformation
swell.policy: animate/fill swell only where the native water footprint is connected to open boundary water; otherwise label it unresolved

wind_wave.source: Open-Meteo Marine API; model selection is not exposed in the response
wind_wave.policy: partial wet cells may show source-backed wind-wave context, but this is not a validated local fetch model

support_geometry.source: native mesh wet triangles plus detailed land geometry
support_geometry.open_water_rule: wet raster pixels connected to the domain boundary through water
support_geometry.limitations: connectivity does not model refraction, diffraction, shoaling, breaking, or attenuation through an entrance

quality.grid_method: nearest wet ROMS rho cell; no extrapolation beyond 0.45 degrees
quality.notes: CBOFS/DBOFS zeta is total free-surface elevation and may include surge and river effects; depth-averaged ROMS u/v are included where available.
